assumptions.statement: The supplied triangular Hong Kong mesh is linearly rasterized to a 96 by 64 longitude-latitude grid.
assumptions.evidence: Interpolation uses faces_0based and preserves the supplied mesh boundary; raw zero marks cells outside it.

assumptions.statement: The primary Unity surface uses all supplied EPSG:4326 nodes and faces without spatial interpolation.
assumptions.evidence: GeoSurface stores 7,364 interleaved lon/lat nodes, 13,445 source faces and one encoded value per original node and hour.

assumptions.statement: Each physical 2D surface is repeated across four display layers; these layers are not physical depth.
assumptions.evidence: For_VR supplies time, node and channel dimensions but no depth dimension.

assumptions.statement: Frames are ordered by event number and then hourly HKT timestamp; gaps between events remain discontinuities.
assumptions.evidence: The six source HDF5 files provide time_hkt arrays and paired filenames.
